rounds.text: Shilp Gravures presents a significant value opportunity as it trades at a price-to-book ratio of 0.99x, effectively priced at ₹ 169 against a book value of ₹ 171 [E2]. This deep discount is evident when comparing its P/B of 0.96x against a much higher sector benchmark of 2.63x [E7]. The company's valuation is further supported by a P/E of 12 [E1], which represents a substantial discount to the sector benchmark of 23.17x [E6]. While undervalued, the business maintains an ROA of 5.53%, which actually outperforms the sector benchmark of 4.93% [E8]. Furthermore, operating margins have improved to 15% in the TTM from 13% three years prior [E29]. The stock sits at only 21% of its 52-week range, conceded: [E5], and the three-year median return on equity is 6%, conceded: [E27]. Nevertheless, the most recent one-year median return on equity has risen to 9%, indicating a positive shift in performance [E28].
